timelinePolicy: Raw time labels only; no formal timeline/event files and no invented dates.

records.summaryRaw: Nanaya family, a demon-hunting family with supernatural ability, was invited by Tohno Makihisa to destroy the Saiki family; Kiri's nonhuman combat strength made Makihisa feel threatened, and Makihisa then joined branch families to destroy Nanaya.
Shiki shielded Akiha from Shiki Tohno's monster attack, suffered a huge chest scar and near-death state, then awakened the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception after the near-death experience.

Shiki leaves early due to anemia, meets a blonde white-clothed woman, his demon-hunting blood awakens and killing impulse loses control, then he follows her and uses the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception and knife to divide her into 17 pieces.

records.timeRaw: first vampiric-impulse episode / after 12th-century origin signal
records.summaryRaw: Original Arcueid was tricked by Roa into drinking his blood during her first vampiric-impulse suffering, lost control, and killed the other True Ancestors in Castle Brunestud; afterward she sealed herself and normally slept in the Millennium Castle, waking only when Roa appeared to execute him.

Remake Arcueid naturally arose around the 12th century to respond to fallen True Ancestors and proliferating Dead Apostles, with specs far beyond her kind, and was raised as a weapon to execute Demon Lords and Dead Apostles.

records.timeRaw: 同人版 / 16岁生日后 / 两天后
records.summaryRaw: Roa appeared on Elesia's sixteenth birthday, exhausted and took over her body; he used the body for a ritual to lure Arcueid and killed the town; Arcueid found and killed Roa two days later, and the Church recovered Elesia's body.

records.timeRaw: 重制版 / 12岁时 / 遗体存放六年后
records.summaryRaw: At age 12 Roa's consciousness began awakening; he later controlled the town and collected blood for a ritual inviting multiple Twenty-seven Ancestors, Arcueid killed the fifteenth Roa, and Elesia's body revived after six years in Church storage.

records.timeRaw: 赴日前 / 感知罗亚再次转生后
records.summaryRaw: Before going to Japan Ciel had subjugated three Twenty-seven Ancestors; after sensing Roa's reincarnation she went to Souya, purged vampires at night, disguised as a student by day, and targeted Tohno Shiki as the suspected Roa host.
